source_script: I've coached postpartum moms back into their bodies for almost fifteen years, and the one thing nobody warns you about is the soft belly pooch that sticks around no matter how many crunches you do. If you're a mom over forty who still looks four months pregnant in every mirror, this is for you. Day one I wrapped this around my waist right after I got out of the shower and just stood in front of the bathroom mirror checking how it sat. By day fourteen I was standing in a dressing room trying on jeans I hadn't fit into since before my second kid, and for the first time in years I didn't have to suck in for the photo.
